name: mostofi
description: Keeps docs true to code: weighted-token doc budget gate (`mostofi check`), stale-doc scanner, and ADR capture.

proactivity.title: Proactivity
proactivity.description: eager: offers a doc pass after code changes. suggest: a one-line offer, then waits. on-request: only when asked or /mostofi is run. A repo's own doc rules still win.

doc_gate.title: Doc-gate reminder
doc_gate.description: The prompt-time reminder to read the conventions first. Off silences it everywhere for you; a repo's [doc-gate] enabled = false silences it for everyone.

steward_consent.title: Steward pass edits
steward_consent.description: apply: edit docs, then report. propose: show the planned edits and wait for a yes. ADRs are always drafted for approval first.

setup_profile.title: Setup profile
setup_profile.description: Profile /mostofi setup proposes for a new repo's .docs.toml; the repo's file decides after that.
